integrity: Analytic all-order proof and a standalone exact rational recurrence test; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to a constant-in-time scalar uniform parameter, a specified uniformly conservative 2-dimensional family, degree-truncated exact Legendre Galerkin and its same-node Gaussian product. It proves existence of unbounded Galerkin coefficient evolutions, not failure for every initial datum, and makes no finite-time degree-asymptotic claim. Equivalent older work remains possible.
title: All-order Legendre–Galerkin instability of a uniformly bounded random Hamiltonian oscillator
